This is the Sprite Strike and is based loosely on how sprites were used heavily in mainstream game development within the 80's.
Due to Nachtfrische's previous request of in-game renders. I tried to get closer to that by rendering it in photoshop so that it showed how it looked when opened within the CSGO workshop workbench. I felt that this would help satisfy the observer on knowing what it would actually look like in game. I have also implemented a new format of showing the wears of the skin, which you are able to view on the steam workshop.
